abstention_policy: No abstention hint to Reactor yet (configs/abstain.json: policy no_abstain_hint_yet, threshold 0.9, hint_to_reactor false). Signal: the routed lens's own pack.abstain_p. On the final routed system over dev+dev200 (45 unanswerable, 606 answerable), routed AUC is 0.719 on dev and 0.808 on dev200, and no threshold gets above about 0.25 precision: at 0.8 there are 13 true abstentions against 43 false ones. Inside their own types the lenses rank well (ssu 0.91, ku 0.89, temporal 0.77/0.97), but their scales differ. On test, 6 of 45 ssu packs score 0.8 or more on probably answerable name questions. Rule to re-enable: a route may add a soft hint ("If none of the passages states this about me, say that our conversations do not contain it."), never a forced abstention, once its abstain_p reaches precision >= 0.7 at recall >= 0.4 on dev+dev200 pooled. Until then abstain_p is used only for packing choices inside lenses.
brief_a:
ROUND 2 BRIEF, STRUCTURE AGENTS (A). Read runs/SYNTHESIS_r1.md first.

Common rules:
- Sweeps now print CF1all/Sall: the metrics if Reactor cites EVERY passage we send. Post-filtering Reactor's citations by cite_plan is not confirmed by the organisers. Report S and Sall on dev and dev200. A variant must win on S (>= 2 on dev, no loss on dev200) without losing more than 2 on Sall.
- Prefer packs whose sessions are close to the cite set over hints.
- New core API: build_pack(..., pinned=[uids], max_chars_per_session=N); hx.rerank_texts(query, texts) and hx.dense_texts(query, texts) give cached sentence-level CE and bge scores.
- per_question rows carry included_turns; harness.failures marks gold turns IN/MISS; harness.audit saves route, cite_plan and debug.
- Routed system: lenses/pipeline.py + configs/best.json. Check misroutes with --route --type <t>.
- Do not add abstention hints to Reactor. Calibrate abstain_p as a probability on dev+dev200 pooled.

ssu-A (a_struct nb3t0, routed winner: dev 93.5, dev200 92.5, Sall 93.2/90.7):
(1) Latest-value phrasing on test ('I last mentioned', 'did I end up naming/using', 'now'), about 15 test ssu questions. Pick the newest affirmed own mention and say so in the hint. Audit sourdough starter, last book, last restaurant, last beer kegged and the National R-77 'end up' values.
(2) Degrade gracefully on KU misroutes (dev200 ku->ssu: S 47.6). When the two best sessions state different values of the same attribute, pack both, newest first, and cite the newest.
(3) Calibrate abstain_p on dev+dev200 pooled; dog name, partner name and favourite colour score 0.8 or more on test.
(4) Value voting for name drift (cat Fig/Sombra/Bica).

ssa-A (a_recsent recqs_cf7, routed winner: 93.3/93.3, saturated):
(1) Cut chars with no PA loss: pack the best turn +-2 turns (or use max_chars_per_session) once turn@1 is confident. Target about 4k chars.
(2) The INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE gate should also require the category word to be missing from the top session (Lisbon/Heden case).
(3) Provide role_guess(q, hx) -> p_assistant from your structural scan and measure its accuracy on dev ssa vs ssu gold. 50 dev ssa questions with no 'you' cue are routed to ssu today.

multi-A (a_tally, runner-up: 83.0/82.2, Sall 66):
(1) Citation-robust packing: 17 passages per question. Pack only sessions with an own, in-window instance sentence plus at most 2 recall sessions.
(2) Export your facet/conjunct-absence check as a function that multi-B can import for abstain_p (B's AUC is 0.64 on dev).
(3) Code-side ledger note (date | session | sentence) with decoy filtering: friends' purchases, 'decided not to buy', 'skipped'. Build it as a variant on top of B's lens via import (lenses/multi/a_*.py), not as a separate pipeline.

ku-A (a_timeline pkd_b2, runner-up, ties B: 92.1/93.1, Sall 83.3/83.8):
(1) Drop the 2 context sessions when the pair is confident; target Sall within 1-2 points of S.
(2) Audit the 5 test questions newly routed to ku: laps each morning, cups of coffee, km each evening, GB mobile data plan, rooms renovated so far. Also audit the paraphrased updates (job title -> promotion, long-run start recap).
(3) Your abstention is the best on ku (AUC 0.94 dev200). Expose abstain_p(q, hx) so the routed ku lens can use it.
(4) Per-owner totals ('neighbor Bjorn and I in total right now').

temporal-A (a_calendar ftb_bm25; through lenses/temporal/merged_r1.py it now serves gap questions, 34 of 36 test temporal, +5 S over B on that subset):
(1) Six test gap questions get no computed value: Montreal alerts -> lease ('tonight/today'), first trail run, first loaf, hive inspection/varroa, wife's birthday/anniversary, Toronto Marathon/Moroccan dinner. Relax min_score when both events are clearly picked, and add the anniversary/birthday/holiday grammar.
(2) When computed is confident, pack only the two event sessions plus at most one runner-up. Test packs carry 8.3 passages now and Sall is about 65.
(3) HA is 0.62 on dev gap questions. Withhold computed near rounding boundaries or when one date is vague, and pick event sentences with hx.rerank_texts (bus/train, smoker).
(4) An abstention rule for questions with no event match ('How many years did I serve as a firefighter?').
Evaluate both through merged_r1 (gap subset) and as your own lens.
brief_b:
ROUND 2 BRIEF, SEMANTIC AGENTS (B). Read runs/SYNTHESIS_r1.md first.

Common rules:
- Sweeps now print CF1all/Sall: the metrics if Reactor cites EVERY passage we send. Post-filtering Reactor's citations by cite_plan is not confirmed by the organisers. Report S and Sall on dev and dev200. A variant must win on S (>= 2 on dev, no loss on dev200) without losing more than 2 on Sall.
- Prefer packs whose sessions are close to the cite set; a short 'cite only the passages that state the answer / each counted item' hint is a secondary option.
- New core API: build_pack(..., pinned=[uids], max_chars_per_session=N); hx.rerank_texts(query, texts) and hx.dense_texts(query, texts) give cached sentence-level CE and bge scores. Call these instead of core.models directly.
- per_question rows carry included_turns; harness.failures marks gold turns IN/MISS; harness.audit saves route, cite_plan and debug.
- Routed system: lenses/pipeline.py + configs/best.json; check misroutes with --route --type <t>.
- Do not add abstention hints to Reactor.

ssu-B (b_sem best_rec, runner-up: S ties A at 93.5/92.6, but Sall is 89.1/86.0 against 93.2/90.7 for A):
(1) Your test packs carry about 6 sessions. Keep decoys out of the passages and name them in the hint instead; keep a decoy session only when it changes the answer.
(2) You degrade much better on KU misroutes (dev200 ku->ssu: S 76.7 vs 47.6 for A). Build lenses/ssu/b_merge.py that imports A's owner/polarity/tense features (lenses/ssu/a_struct.py) and adds your recall sweep and recency pair. It must beat A on the routed ssu route (--route --type ssu) on S without losing Sall.
(3) Fix 'last mentioned' cites: on the test grill question you cited the Weber kettle session, not the newest one (returned the Weber, bought a Big Green Egg).

ssa-B (b_semantic session10k1_rr, runner-up 92.5/93.1; the type is saturated):
(1) Build an evidence-based role detector role_guess(q, hx) -> p_assistant: compare the best assistant-unit CE logit with the best user-unit CE logit in the top sessions. Measure accuracy on dev ssa vs ssu gold. 50 cue-less dev ssa questions route to ssu today (S 70 there against 93). The integrator will wire the detector into the router.
(2) Sentence-level trimming of non-best turns (hx.rerank_texts) down to about 4k chars with no PA loss.

multi-B (b_sweep deep8_10k, routed winner: 86.6/85.2, Sall 73.9/73.5):
(1) Citation robustness: test packs carry 11.7 passages for 3.1 cites. Add a CE relevance floor for depth units, drop sessions with no instance unit, and try a short hint ('cite only the passages that contain a counted item'). Accept on S and Sall.
(2) KU-style counts land in multi: 29 dev ku questions route to multi (S 91). When the same item is restated with a new number, say 'the latest statement wins' in the hint.
(3) Category -> instance misses ('projects led' -> poster/case competition, 'health devices' -> hearing aids): run sentence-level CE via hx.rerank_texts over the user units of the top sessions.
(4) Missing-facet abstain_p: import multi-A's facet check (dev AUC is 0.64).

ku-B (b_semantic pair_r1b, routed winner: 93.2/93.1, Sall 83.9/83.8):
(1) Pack only the cited pair when it is confident. If Reactor cites everything, the 2 context sessions cost about 0.33 CF1.
(2) Audit the 5 test questions newly routed to ku ('these days', 'my current', 'so far': laps, cups of coffee, km each evening, GB data plan, rooms renovated) and the paraphrased updates (current job title -> promotion to Director).
(3) Phrase-level (bigram) abstention for entity swaps ('Italian restaurants', 'Software Engineer Manager').
(4) Build an evidence-based detector ku_pair_p(q, hx) for the router: today 25 dev ku questions go to ssu and 32 to multi. Report its false-positive rate on dev ssu and multi questions, because a misroute of multi into ku costs about 70 S per question.

temporal-B (b_sem sem_turns9; through lenses/temporal/merged_r1.py it now serves the non-gap temporal questions):
(1) Improve the whole-question route (dev S 64.6 on its 40 questions): aggregate 'since I last / in a row / how many X before Y' questions, and an adaptive cite count (1-2 for single answers, N for 'order of the N ...').
(2) The second gold turn in 'first' questions (the sem_turns direction).
(3) For gap questions where lens A gives no computed value (6 on test), offer your CE event picks and computed value as a fallback. Build it as a copy of merged_r1 at lenses/temporal/b_merge.py.
(4) Pack fewer sessions: Sall is 71-75 against S 76-82.
notes: Committed as 'Round 1 merge' (0df37c5). configs/best.json routes: ssu a_struct nb3t0, ssa a_recsent recqs_cf7, multi b_sweep deep8_10k, ku b_semantic pair_r1b, temporal merged_r1 gapA_semB; the fallback is generic hybrid_rr. The previous config is kept in configs/best_r0.json.
All per-type comparisons used the full gold-type sets on both splits (no --limit), so no fair re-runs were needed. The only partial run was multi-A ledger (40 q), which was not a candidate.

ssu is an S tie (A 93.47/92.54 vs B 93.53/92.58). I picked A for citation robustness: Sall is 93.2/90.7 for A against 89.1/86.0 for B, because B packs about 6 sessions on test. The test audit also favoured A's cites (younger son Daniel, pilau, grill = Big Green Egg).
ku is a tie (B +1.1 dev, 0.0 dev200). B was picked for fewer chars and PA 1.000. A has the better AUC (0.94 on dev200).

New merge lenses/temporal/merged_r1.py: gap questions go to A ftb_bm25, the rest to B sem_turns9. On the type as a whole it gains only +1.1 dev and +1.2 dev200 over B, below the 2-point rule. I adopted it because 34 of 36 test temporal questions are gap questions, where A beats B by +5.0 (dev) and +5.3 (dev200).

Routed system: dev S 80.4 and dev200 79.9, against 78.3/78.5 before the router fix and generic hybrid_rr at 73.4 (80 dev q). With gold routing the winners would give about 87.3 on dev; the gap is mostly dev-only phrasing (50 cue-less ssa questions go to ssu; ku questions without a cue go to ssu or multi). Test routes look clean: ssu 45, temporal 36, ssa 25, multi 20, ku 20.
Router accuracy: dev 0.633 -> 0.658, dev200 0.584 -> 0.632. Ambiguous counts stay multi on purpose: ku->multi costs little (S 91) but multi->ku is catastrophic (S 16.5).

Citation trade-off: CF1 is measured on cite_plan and is optimistic. Routed dev CF1 is 0.877 on the plan against 0.694 if Reactor cites every passage (S 80.4 vs Sall 74.9). Multi drops 0.87->0.44, temporal 0.83->0.65, ku 0.96->0.64. The harness now reports CF1all/Sall; round-2 acceptance requires no Sall loss over 2.

Core requests done: build_pack pinned/max_chars_per_session, hx.rerank_texts/dense_texts, CF1all/Sall, included_turns in per_question, failures IN/MISS marks, audit saving route/cite_plan/debug, CONTRACT.md docs.

Core requests declined: model-server priority (the server must not be restarted), the core.units abbreviation guard (it would invalidate unit ids and caches), a temporal PA redefinition (comparability), --ablate-gold (needs a re-index), and answer-anchored citation filtering (not confirmed by the organisers).

Test audit of the routed system: 15 of 146 flagged. 8 are ssu with abstain_p >= 0.5, mostly name questions that are probably answerable. 7 are temporal: 6 gap questions with no computed value, plus 'years served as a firefighter', which is probably unanswerable.
The synthesis is in runs/SYNTHESIS_r1.md. runs/ is gitignored, so the file is not in the commit.
